text: From: New York Law360 <news@law360.com> To: Subject: NY Bar Says Attys Can Rent Out Offices In Co-Working Biz Date: Wed, 26 May 2021 08:08:08 +0000 ly Law360 New York NEW YORK Wednesday, May 26, 2021 TOP NEWS NY Bar Says Attys Can Rent Out Offices In Co-Working Biz New York-based attorneys are permitted to run a nonlegal business that consists of renting out law office space to other lawyers, the New York State Bar Association committee on legal ethics said in an opinion issued Tuesday.
